in_hindi.name: केवल
in_hindi.long_meaning: एक-एक (one-one), वह जो एक है (the one who is)

in_marathi.name: Keval
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Perfect, Complete, Absolute
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keval हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Keval signifies a state of being where one has attained complete knowledge and understanding. It is a state of pure consciousness and absolute truth. In Hinduism, it is a term used to describe a sage or a person who has achieved the ultimate goal of self-realization.
